assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: optional cinematic bitmap element for Ichido promo preproduction, to be composited over backgrounds by a motion designer.
Primary request: create one premium sculptural layered cobalt ribbon with free ends. This is an abstract sound sculpture, not a logo, icon, brand mark, or literal audio data.
Style/medium: exceptionally refined photorealistic 3D studio render, tactile folded laminated paper or silk-like satin; beautifully resolved thin parallel layers and crisp physical edges.
Subject: a single continuous band built from about 14 parallel ultramarine/cobalt strips that travels in a smooth horizontal organic sound-wave curvature, two relaxed waves, open tapered free ends, elegant shallow camera perspective. Broad landscape silhouette. Color inspired by saturated cobalt #2454ec and deep ultramarine in the folds, no color gradients other than lighting.
Composition: full object visible, centered in a wide landscape composition approximately 16:9, generous transparent margins, no clipping, no separate stray strips; long axis nearly horizontal with gentle diagonal depth.
Lighting: soft directional studio lighting and realistic self-shadow inside its folds.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent background with clean alpha. No floor, no ground plane, no contact shadow outside object, no color field, no baked checkerboard.
Constraints: object only; no text, no UI, no logo, no watermark, no particles, no human, no scenery. Maintain exceptionally smooth sculptural craftsmanship. High resolution, production-quality material detail.
